description: Poll until puppetserver responds on port 8140, and with puppetdb=true until OpenVoxDB responds on its plain-text port as well, or a timeout expires. On a timeout, the error says why: the service state and the last error the service logged, such as puppetserver's startup memory check

max_wait.description: Maximum seconds to wait before failing, for both services together (default: 300)

puppetdb.description: Also wait for OpenVoxDB, on the port its jetty.ini names (default: false)
